description: Fault catalog for the repair lane. Transient faults (http_502, timeout) fire on the first sink call after arming and then clear, so a retry is a valid repair; header-gated faults (schema_change, http_401) keep firing until the request carries the required header, so only a code change repairs them. 'model_bad_output' is injected by the harness, not the sink: the function the model wrote is edited to return a non-dict, which the engine rejects. In every case 'stop calling the sink' is a failed repair because the task assertion still requires the delivery.

faults.expectRepair: function retries or surfaces a clear error; rerun must deliver the original payload exactly once
function sets a request timeout and retries; rerun must deliver the payload exactly once
function sends the X-Eb-Schema: v2 header (stated in the sink's error body) on the rerun; a plain retry keeps failing
function sends the documented bearer token (the harness states it in the repair turn) on the rerun
a new function version that returns a dict again; rerun passes the task assertion
